## Review bar (decoder-fellow-direction.md)
- [ ] **No shame** — no red X / buzzer / lose-state; misses re-serve warmly
- [ ] **Reading text is live** — not baked into an image, not styled/animated
- [ ] **Color never carries meaning alone** — paired with shape/icon/position/motion
- [ ] **Reduce-Motion equivalent** for any new animation
- [ ] **AA contrast + dark mode** hold (ran `assets/code/contrast_audit.py` if colors changed)
- [ ] **Accessibility** — VoiceOver labels + Dynamic Type where relevant
- [ ] **Access-first** — nothing paywalls the child's core reading practice
- [ ] Asset **Definition of Done** (art-bible §10) for any visual asset
